terms.definition: A data point sitting far from the rest of the dataset.
terms.function: Still a data point — but a dramatic one.
terms.whereItIs: The isolated dot with the question mark.
terms.whyItMatters: Outliers can bend summaries and reveal real events.

terms.definition: The tight bunch of ordinary values most points sit in.
terms.function: The reference group that makes the outlier stand out.
terms.whereItIs: The packed middle group of dots.
terms.whyItMatters: Where values live; the outlier is defined against this.

terms.definition: The empty space separating the outlier from the cluster.
terms.function: This gap is what makes it an outlier.
terms.whereItIs: The space between cluster and lone dot.
terms.whyItMatters: The gap is measurable, not a feeling.

terms.definition: The different way the outlier moves the mean, range, and median.
terms.function: Pulls the mean and range; leaves the median.
terms.whyItMatters: Knowing the effects keeps you from misreading a dataset.
